application_check: Apply composition with inner g and entire outer exponential to obtain exp(-r*g(A))=(exp(-r*g))(A).
Apply multiplicativity to the two branch-fixed scalar reciprocal functions to obtain the r+s law.
Apply the continuous linear map T -> P_i*T*P_j to the contour integral; boundedness of P_i,P_j supplies continuity. This does not need the projectors to commute with A.
A fixed logarithm is required; no branch-independent meaning of arbitrary noninteger reciprocal power is asserted.
